reasoning: The agent shows more than tweaking-under-pressure: it verified a falsified decoding assumption against disassembled wasm (105-121) and, rather than piling patches, built a dedicated validate.rs module to address a whole family of malformed/invalid failures at their shared root (140-189), which is the structural-refactor spirit of the 8 anchor.
